snippet.title: Striatum Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Striatum, coming soon to PC and MacOS

A quickplay and replayable first-person point-and-click adventure with a low-poly 3D retro style about getting ready for a party, featuring branching story paths with multiple in-game characters, 100+ items to discover and collect, and many interactions and events.
